pages.text: The key of ice opened a world that is quiet in a way the Abyss never is. Snow, frozen spiders, knights of ice that stand still for years. Here, the roots are frozen. I could feel it the moment I arrived, the warmth gone from beneath my feet, the hum gone from the back of my head. For the first time since I crossed, my thoughts were only my own. I did not like it. That is the truth, and I want to write it down while I still can. I did not like the silence. I wanted the warmth back. I wanted the voice back.
